qe: In the autumn of 1780 the United Netherlands joined the league against England, and England declared war on the Dutch on which date?
qh: 1780 की शरद ऋतु में संयुक्त नीदरलैंड्स इंग्लैंड के विरुद्ध गठबंधन में शामिल हुआ, तथा इंग्लैंड ने डचों के विरुद्ध किस तारीख़ को युद्ध की घोषणा की?
e: America ke svatantrata sangram ke dauran England ka mukabla sirf America se nahi, balki Europe ke ek bade gathbandhan se bhi tha. 1780 ki sharad ritu me United Netherlands bhi England ke virodh me bane us gathbandhan me shamil ho gaya. Iske jawab me England ne 20 December 1780 ko Dutch ke khilaf yuddh ki ghoshna kar di tatha unki bastiyon ko kabze me lene ka karye shuru kar diya. Yah ghoshna Bharat me bhi turant asar dikhane lagi, kyunki Bengal tatha Bihar me Dutch ki kai kothiyan tatha Chowkiyan maujood thin. Aage chalkar 22 June 1781, 3 July 1781 tatha 6 January 1782 ki tareekhein isi yuddh ki badi ghatnaon se judi hain. Exam point: 1780 ki sharad ritu me United Netherlands England ke virodhi gathbandhan me shamil hua tatha 20 December 1780 ko England ne Dutch ke khilaf yuddh ki ghoshna ki; is yuddh ka asar Bharat me bhi pada aur Dutch bastiyan kabze me aane lagi.

qe: Which group of Dutch settlements in southern India was seized by the English by the end of the year 1781?
qh: 1781 के अंत तक अंग्रेज़ों ने दक्षिण भारत की डच बस्तियों के किस समूह पर कब्ज़ा कर लिया था?
e: Dutch ki dakshin Bharat me teen prasiddh bastiyan thi - Sadras, Pulicat tatha Negapatam. Yah teeno samudra-tat ke aise sthal the jahan se unka vyapar tatha jahazi aana-jaana chalta tha. 1780 ke aakhir me yuddh shuru hone ke baad angrezi sena tatha jahazi bade ke saath in par hamla hua tatha 1781 ke ant tak teeno angrezi kabze me aa gayin. Ceylon ki bastiyan - Trincomali tatha Fort Ostenburg - alag hain; woh 1782 ki shuruaat me kabze me aayin. Chinsura tatha Baranagore Bengal ki Dutch bastiyan thi, tatha Goa, Cochin tatha Cannanore Portuguese bastiyan thi. Exam point: dakshin Bharat ki teen Dutch bastiyan - Sadras, Pulicat tatha Negapatam - 1781 ke ant tak angrezi kabze me aa gayin; Ceylon ki bastiyan 1782 ki shuruaat me kabze me aayin.

qe: Trincomali and Fort Ostenburg on Ceylon were captured on 6 January 1782 by the British fleet under which Admiral, together with a very large property in military stores, one lakh fifty thousand dollars in specie and two Indiamen?
qh: 6 जनवरी 1782 को सीलोन के त्रिंकोमाली तथा फ़ोर्ट ऑस्टेनबर्ग पर किस एडमिरल के नेतृत्व वाले ब्रिटिश बेड़े ने कब्ज़ा किया, जहाँ सैनिक सामान, एक लाख पचास हज़ार डॉलर की नक़दी तथा यूरोप जाने को तैयार दो इंडियामैन भी मिलीं?
e: Ceylon par Dutch ki do ahem bastiyan thi - Trincomali tatha Fort Ostenburg. 6 January 1782 ko British fleet ne Admiral Sir Edward Hughes ke netritva me in dono par kabza kar liya. Is kabze me bahut bada sainik bhandar, yaani astra-shastra tatha saman, 1,50,000 dollar ki nakadi - jise specie kaha jaata hai - tatha do Indiamen jahaz, jo Europe jaane ke liye taiyar the, angrezi haath lage. Indiaman ka matlab hai East India Company ka bada vyaparik jahaz. Kuch itihaskaron ne is kabze ko 1781 me hua likha tha, lekin sarkari records se spasht hota hai ki yah 6 January 1782 ko hua tha. Exam point: Trincomali tatha Fort Ostenburg 6 January 1782 ko Admiral Sir Edward Hughes ke netritva wale British fleet ne capture kiye; usme bada sainik bhandar, 1,50,000 dollar ki nakadi tatha do Indiamen bhi mili.

qe: What had Captain Parr, commanding the sloop Chater, already captured when he reported on 2 July 1781 to the Governor-General, after receiving orders to make reprisals on the Dutch?
qh: स्लूप चेटर के कमांडर कैप्टन पार ने 2 जुलाई 1781 को गवर्नर-जनरल को रिपोर्ट देते समय पहले ही क्या पकड़ लिया था, क्योंकि उन्हें डचों पर प्रतिकार की आज्ञा मिल चुकी थी?
e: Sir Edward Hughes ne Madras pahunchne ke baad 22 June 1781 ko Captain Parr ko nirdesh bheje. Captain Parr His Majesty ke sloop Chater ke commander the. Nirdesh ka aashay yah tha ki States General yaani Dutch sangh ke jahazon, maal tatha prajaon par poore bal se pratikar yaani reprisal ke karye ko anjaam diya jaye. Isi nirdesh ke tehat Captain Parr ne chand hi dinon me Dutch ke char pilot sloop pakad liye tatha 2 July 1781 ko Governor-General ko iski report di. Pilot sloop ek chhota jahaz hota tha, jo bade jahazon ko bandargah ke raste dikhata tatha unhe sahi jagah pahunchata tha. Exam point: Captain Parr ko 22 June 1781 ko Dutch par pratikar ka nirdesh mila; uske tehat unhone char Dutch pilot sloop pakad liye tatha 2 July 1781 ko Governor-General ko report di.

qe: On which date did the Governor-General's Council at Calcutta resolve that war between Great Britain and the States of Holland should be considered as ascertained and declared, and that not an instant should be lost in carrying its measures into execution?
qh: कलकत्ता में गवर्नर-जनरल की काउंसिल ने किस तारीख़ को तय किया कि ग्रेट ब्रिटेन तथा स्टेट्स ऑफ़ हॉलैंड के बीच युद्ध को निश्चित तथा घोषित माना जाएगा तथा उसके उपायों को लागू करने में एक क्षण भी नहीं गँवाया जाएगा?
e: Captain Parr ki report, jismein yuddh ki khabar tatha pakde gaye Dutch jahaz shamil the, 3 July 1781 ko Calcutta me Governor-General ki Council ke saamne rakhi gayi. Usi din Council ne faisla kiya ki Great Britain tatha States of Holland ke beech yuddh ko nishchit tatha ghoshit maana jayega, chahe uska ailan aam tareeke se nahi hua tha, tatha is soochna ke aadhar par sambandhi sabhi upay turant lagu kiye jayenge. Council ne yah bhi maana ki is kaam me ek kshan bhi nahi ganwaya ja sakta kyunki deri hone par Dutch apni bastiyan surakshit kar sakte the. Is faisle ke baad Bengal tatha Bihar ki Dutch bastiyon ko kabze me lene ki taiyari tez ho gayi. Exam point: 3 July 1781 ko Calcutta ki Council ne Captain Parr ki report ke aadhar par tay kiya ki Holland ke saath yuddh ghoshit maana jayega tatha uske upayon ko turant lagu kiya jayega; isse Bengal tatha Bihar ki Dutch bastiyon par karwai tez hui.

qe: In a letter of 28 April 1781 defending the proposed treaty with the Dutch, Hastings denied that the Dutch soldier was contemptible and said that some of the best soldiers ever employed in India had taken service with the English after their defeat in which campaign?
qh: 28 अप्रैल 1781 के पत्र में डचों के साथ प्रस्तावित संधि का बचाव करते हुए हेस्टिंग्स ने यह मानने से इनकार किया कि डच सैनिक तुच्छ है तथा कहा कि भारत में अब तक सेवा देने वाले कुछ सर्वोत्तम सैनिक वे थे, जो किस अभियान में पराजय के बाद अंग्रेज़ों की सेवा में आए थे?
e: Dutch ke saath prastavit sandhi ka virodh ho raha tha, isliye Hastings ne apne mitra Scott ko 28 April 1781 ke patra me uske paksh me tark likhe. Ek aitraaz yah tha ki Dutch sainik tuchh yaani kamzor hota hai, lekin Hastings ne ise galat batate hue kaha ki Bharat me ab tak sabse achhe sainik humne hi rakhe hain, jinme Dutch tatha khas taur par German the, jo Colonel Forde ke abhiyan me parajit hone ke baad angrezi seva me aa gaye the. Unhone yah bhi kaha ki Dutch afsaron ki tankhwah itni kam thi ki achhe gentleman officer unke saath nahi jude, isliye prastav me Captain se upar ke ran ke officer na lene ki shart rakhi gayi thi. Exam point: Hastings ne Colonel Forde ke abhiyan me parajit hokar angrezi seva me aane wale Dutch tatha German sainikon ko Bharat ke sabse achhe sainikon me gina tatha Dutch sainik ko tuchh batane wale aitraaz ko galat kaha.
